messages:
Linh Tran: FYI — Atlantis reported a new MLOps team and product-analytics splitting into its own org. They submitted a capacity ask for embeddings + chat and we observed ~3x QPS spike in the last 48h. Opening touch: support#3421. @Carlos can you take lead on the commercial follow-up?

Samir Patel: Any PII here? Do they want Private deployment or Dedicated? If Hosted we can temporarily scale but cost will spike. :thinking:

Maya Gomez: deploy-bot flagged the spike earlier. Recommend Dedicated reserved capacity for predictable latency. Suggest reserving 2x current GPUs with a burst policy. I'll draft a config and perf sim.

deploy-bot: [alert] Atlantis throughput increased 3.2x in 48h. top-model: redwood-chat-medium, avg-latency 220ms, error-rate 0.4%.

Carlos Ruiz: I'm on it. This looks more like expansion than churn risk but we should move QBR earlier. Can we get a per-route and per-model usage breakdown? Also need a 6-month uplift estimate for commercial.

Linh Tran: Quick usage slice: total_tokens/day up 280% over last 2 days. No obvious PII flagged in a cursory scan. I'll run a deeper audit with Security to confirm before we recommend Private.

Maya Gomez: Draft config (preview):
```
reserved_capacity:
  gpus: 4
  policy:
    burst_allowed: true
    min_instances: 2
model_preferences:
  - redwood-chat-medium
  - redwood-embed-large
routing_policy:
  latency_priority: true
```
Estimated monthly cost delta: +$9.5k if reserved vs +$18k if we rely on hosted auto-scale. I'll follow up with Optimize recommendations (quantization + batching) to reduce the delta.

Samir Patel: Can we offer a 3-month Dedicated pilot with trial pricing? That reduces commercial friction and gives them migration runway.

Carlos Ruiz: Agreed. Proposed pilot success metrics: p95 latency < 300ms, cost per 1k tokens < $0.003, onboarding for 2 teams within 30 days. I'll draft the SOW language.

Linh Tran: Next steps: Maya to share perf sim + cost/latency tradeoffs; Samir to confirm security/PII and whether they need VPC; Carlos to schedule a QBR with their head of infra and pricing. I'll book internal enablement with Solutions Eng + Onboarding for next Wed. :calendar:

Maya Gomez: Will run perf sim today and post results here by EOD tomorrow. Also will include a quick run of Optimize suggestions (batch sizes, cache TTLs).

Carlos Ruiz: Thanks — ping me when the perf sim and estimated uplift are posted, I'll prep the pilot contract and pricing options.

Linh Tran: Thanks team — marking this high-priority. /cc @deploy-bot for continued metric updates and I'll update support#3421 with the plan.
